children: Palantir Technologies Inc. (NASDAQ: PLTR) will host its eleventh AIPCon on Thursday, September 10, 2026.

AIPCon 11 will feature some of the most consequential institutions in aviation, technology, media, insurance, defense, healthcare, and manufacturing. Presenting customers include Acrisure, Cisco, Eaton, Federal Aviation Administration, Hexion, L3Harris, Novartis, NVIDIA, Ondas Sentinel, USA TODAY, Zeta Global, and others.

Each customer will take the stage to show how they are deploying Palantir’s Ontology, Foundry, AIP, and Sovereign AI to tackle complex challenges — including optimizing the world’s most critical supply chains, building an AI operating system for insurance, connecting customer intelligence to marketing and revenue workflows, advancing drone and autonomy operations, improving audience engagement, delivering software in highly regulated government environments, and more.
AIPCon 11 will also mark a series of new and expanded announcements across Palantir’s customer ecosystem.
Online viewers will get access to exclusive customer content and behind-the-scenes material. AIPCon 11 will be available via live stream
